Xe.bar_b_note: A is readable, but the panel lacks controller-first glyphs and the teal/gold accent hierarchy of a shipping UI.

Yg.bar_b_note: A flat, saturated lawn and a placeholder grass slab over the gate sink it despite a good sky.

Nb.bar_b_note: The dome landmark carries it, but the uniform grass foreground and flat midday light keep it below the Palworld finish.

Vd.bar_b_note: The outfit silhouette is fine, but the stiff face and dead eyes are below Palworld character finish.

Sa.bar_b_note: Magenta ring telegraphs, an invisible player creature, foliage blocking the camera (B) and no storm atmosphere sink it.

Ql.bar_b_note: B is close and on the owner style bar for fur and lightning; A's material breaking in the faint poses and the floating body hold it back.

Stormwood fight view: camera collision with or fade-out of trunks and canopy, rim-light the player creature, replace the magenta ring telegraphs with lightning or stone effects under a purple storm sky
Replace the gate's flat grass/rock cap slab with a modelled pale-stone crag/arch hero piece
